name: NEXTDC S4 Sydney

address.value: 16 Johnston Crescent, Horsley Park NSW (Lot 305 DP 1275011)
address.note: Some listings (datacenterHawk, datacentermap) give 3-5 Johnston Crescent; the SSD application and Multiplex use 16 Johnston Crescent

postcode.note: standard postcode for Horsley Park; not stated in the sources consulted

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 16 Johnston Crescent (large lot; campus-level)

builder.note: head contractor; engaged on design April 2022, ECI from mid-2024, construction started 2026

mw_it.note: SSD-63741210 describes a 250 MW data centre. NEXTDC/Multiplex market S4 as 350 MW (NEXTDC later quotes 365 MW total, including a Phase 2 SSD); the 2021 ASX release targeted 300 MW

mw_grid.note: dual 330 kV feeders from Transgrid Sydney West substation; grid MW not found

cost_aud_m.note: media figure (The Urban Developer headline, 'NextDC $1.1bn data centre under way'), not the planning CIV. Other reports say $1.2bn. EIS CIV not seen because the planning portal was unreachable. Land cost about $124m in 2021 (source 5)

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
authority.note: determined by an Executive Director under delegation

reference.note: SEARs request 16 Oct 2023 under PDA-63433217. There is a separate 'NEXTDC S4 Data Centre Phase 2' project on the portal (reference not found)

lodged.note: estimate: inferred from the June 2024 (2024-06-20) upload timestamps of the SSDA documents on the portal. Exact lodgement date not confirmed

determined.note: Mod-1 approved Aug 2026 per master.csv notes (not re-verified)

jobs_construction.note: Multiplex: 1,800 workers onsite at peak construction

jobs_construction_other.note: NEXTDC ASX release 28 Jul 2021: 'more than 500 jobs during the development phase'

construction_start.note: work commenced / ground broken March 2026 (Multiplex release, early April 2026 coverage)

construction_end.note: expected mid-2027 for the first stage (two four-storey buildings, 30,743 sqm)

open_questions: capital investment value in EIS/assessment report not verified (planning portal blocked); $1.1bn is a media figure
exact SSD lodgement date and operational jobs figure not found
MW: consent 250 MW vs marketed 350/365 MW; Phase 2 SSD reference and scope unknown
number of buildings: SSD search summary says 5, master.csv note says 6; stage 1 is 2 buildings
jobs: basis/scope tagged from search-result wording; confirm against planning documents
